summary: Iteration 12 — Testing the user bug 'Naši radovi uopšte klijent ne vidi' (client never sees the 'Our Works' gallery section). Tested both backend and frontend end-to-end. BUG NOT REPRODUCIBLE on the current build. Backend: 9/9 tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_gallery_visibility_iter12.py — public GET /api/gallery returns items, GET /api/gallery/files/{file} serves bytes (content-type image/*), GET /api/settings exposes gallery_visible, PATCH /api/admin/settings toggles it (401 without x-admin-password), and URLs returned by the backend contain NO trailing whitespace or newlines. Frontend (Expo web preview, 390×844 viewport): seeded one TEST_ gallery item + gallery_visible=true → clients SEE [data-testid=home-gallery] with the 'Naši radovi' heading and one gallery card whose <Image> loads (naturalWidth>0); toggled gallery_visible=false → the entire section disappears (home-gallery not in DOM, text count=0). The frontend condition in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:95-142 is correct: section renders iff gallery.length>0 AND settings.gallery_visible!==false. If the real user still doesn't see 'Naši radovi' it is a data/config issue on their deployment (gallery empty, OR gallery_visible accidentally set to false), NOT a product bug on this preview backend. All seed data cleaned up after test (uploaded item deleted, gallery_visible restored to true).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on every page load: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — pre-existing, not blocking, but should be migrated to the new shadow API. Reference: run `grep -rn "shadowColor\|shadowOffset\|shadowOpacity\|shadowRadius" /app/frontend` to locate the StyleSheet entries.

action_items: No code change required for the reported bug — the gallery visibility feature is working end-to-end (backend + frontend). If the real user still cannot see 'Naši radovi' on their device, instruct them to: (a) open Admin → Settings → verify 'Vidljivost galerije' toggle is ON; (b) open Admin → Galerija and confirm at least one image is uploaded. The frontend intentionally hides the section when there are 0 images (see /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:96).

Optional UX improvement for E1: when gallery_visible=true AND gallery.length===0, consider showing an admin-only hint (or an empty placeholder) so the owner doesn't get confused thinking the toggle is broken.
Optional: migrate the deprecated `shadow*` StyleSheet props to `boxShadow` to silence the React Native Web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:95-142 — GalleryBlock correctly guards on both `gallery.length === 0` and `settings?.gallery_visible === false`. Rendered inside both the FlatList ListFooterComponent (slots list case) and the empty-state ScrollView, so clients see 'Naši radovi' in both branches.

/app/frontend/src/api.ts:150-151 — galleryImageUrl helper correctly prefixes relative URLs with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; verified via browser that resulting src URLs load successfully with no trailing whitespace or newlines.
/app/backend/server.py:304-307 — GET /api/gallery is public (no admin header required), sorted by sort_order then created_at desc, excludes _id. Correct.

/app/backend/server.py:452-464 — admin_upload_gallery strips the caption (line 460) but does NOT strip the storage URLs — this is fine because they are constructed internally from a UUID, not user input, so no trailing-newline risk.

rca_of_issue: The user's complaint 'Naši radovi uopšte klijent ne vidi' cannot be reproduced against the current preview backend+frontend. Root causes to communicate to the user: (1) The home-screen 'Naši radovi' section is intentionally hidden when the admin has not uploaded ANY gallery images (gallery.length===0 branch in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:96); (2) It is also hidden when settings.gallery_visible has been toggled to false by the admin. Both guards are working correctly as verified by 9 backend tests + 2 Playwright assertions. The user should check both conditions on their deployment. The 'trailing newline' hint in the (truncated) bug report is not a backend concern: GET /api/gallery URLs are machine-generated UUIDs with no whitespace, and the frontend galleryImageUrl helper performs a plain `${BASE}${url}` concatenation that works correctly (verified: image src loads naturalWidth>0 in-browser).
